# Med'EqualiTeam

> Medical NGO (since 2018) providing free primary healthcare for refugees and displaced people. Volunteer-powered and crowdfunded; 100% of donations go to operations. Registered charity W102001158, Megevette, France.

Preferred citation URL: https://medequali.team

## Mission

Med'EqualiTeam provides free primary health care for refugees and displaced populations who face financial, social, and logistical obstacles in accessing healthcare. Teams are multilingual (with embedded translators) and rely on international medical volunteers.
